name: AsyncHow-based Agentic Systems Dataset
description: A specialized dataset derived from the AsyncHow dataset designed to enable in-depth analysis and evaluation of agentic systems performing dynamic task decomposition and tool integration. It supports novel evaluation metrics tailored to assess structural and operational aspects of agentic frameworks across diverse tasks.
reputation: A niche research dataset with limited public adoption so far, mainly useful for studying agentic system decomposition and tool-use evaluation.
notes: Introduces novel evaluation metrics for agentic systems; dataset enables analysis of multi-hop task graphs and tool usage; focuses on dynamic and asynchronous task execution.
